result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue on the promotional banner where white text is placed over a very light mint-green background, making it difficult to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a very light mint-green background, resulting in severely insufficient color contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background (e.g., to a rich dark green) or change the text color to dark green/charcoal to meet WCAG contrast standards.
